st: Why we should marvel, especially today, at the complexity of the world around us.

sec.t: ff.21.1 The magic of home-delivered salad and the Bic pen
sec.p: Tim Urban is a lovely guy. He runs the site Wait But Why (a container of deep concepts comically delivered with MS Paint graphics) and was a guest on the Lex Fridman Podcast. At the start of the chat, they talk about the complexity of the world around us.

sec.t: ff.21.2 The end of an era?
sec.p: And yet, since 2008 there seem to be some signs of crisis in this idyllic world. Or not? Let's take a closer look.
